episodes.title: A Lying Witch and a Warden
episodes.summary: When Luz stumbles upon a portal to a magical realm, she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and a tiny warrior, King.

episodes.title: Witches Before Wizards
episodes.summary: An ancient wizard gives Luz a map for a mystical quest.

episodes.title: I Was a Teenage Abomination
episodes.summary: Luz sneaks into the local magic school to help a friend and makes a new enemy in the process.

episodes.title: The Intruder
episodes.summary: Luz and King must defend The Owl House from a mysterious intruder.

episodes.title: Covention
episodes.summary: Luz's lesson about witch covens goes awry when she finds herself thrust into a witch's duel.

episodes.title: Hooty's Moving Hassle
episodes.summary: When Luz, Willow and Gus accidentally animate the Owl House, the house runs amok around Bonesborough.

episodes.title: Lost in Language
episodes.summary: While checking out the library, Luz's pranks lead to unintended consequences.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Swap
episodes.summary: A simple disagreement leads to a complex situation when Eda, King and Luz triple-down on a wager.

episodes.title: Something Ventured, Someone Framed
episodes.summary: When Gus sneaks Luz into Hexside School to present at the Human Appreciation Society, Luz sees a side of the school she didn't expect.

episodes.title: Escape of the Palisman
episodes.summary: When an adventure with Eda's staff goes awry, Luz and her friends have to earn the staff back from a mysterious forest creature, or lose the staff forever.

episodes.title: Sense and Insensitivity
episodes.summary: When King becomes a bestselling author, he learns a valuable lesson in reading the fine print.

episodes.title: Adventures in the Elements
episodes.summary: Luz needs to learn a new spell, so Eda takes her to the most magical place on the island to train.

episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.summary: During Luz's first day of Magic School, curiosity gets the best of her, and she finds herself thrown into the Delinquent Track, where she's not allowed to learn magic.

episodes.title: Really Small Problems
episodes.summary: King confides in a carnival fortune teller who makes his dream come true, but it comes at a cost.

episodes.title: Understanding Willow
episodes.summary: Luz, Willow, and Amity take a trip down Memory Lane.

episodes.title: Enchanting Grom Fright
episodes.summary: Luz experiences Grom, Hexside's version of Prom, and it's not what she expects.

episodes.title: Wing It Like Witches
episodes.summary: Not your average underdog story.

episodes.title: Agony of a Witch
episodes.summary: On a school field trip to the mysterious Emperor's Castle, Luz strays from the group and into danger.

episodes.title: Young Blood, Old Souls
episodes.summary: Luz's skills as a witch are put to the test when she attempts the impossible.

episodes.title: Separate Tides
episodes.summary: Luz feels guilty about Eda losing her powers, so she sets sail in search of a lucrative bounty to help the Owl House.

episodes.title: Escaping Expulsion
episodes.summary: When Amity Blight's parents get Luz, Willow and Gus expelled from Hexside, Luz strikes a dangerous deal with them to get back into school.

episodes.title: Echoes of the Past
episodes.summary: King's delusions of grandeur lead Luz, Lilith and Hooty to a dangerous new island.

episodes.title: Keeping Up A-fear-ances
episodes.summary: Eda gets an unwelcome visit from a family member who puts a strain on everyone in the Owl House.

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass Ruins
episodes.summary: Gus tries to impress a group of cool kids from Glandus High; Luz and Amity journey into the most dangerous section of the library.

episodes.title: Hunting Palismen
episodes.summary: It's Palisman Pairing Day at Hexside! But Luz doesn't match with a Palisman of her own and soon she finds herself on an unexpected journey with a foe.

episodes.title: Eda's Requiem
episodes.summary: A person from Eda's past enlists her in a rebellion against the Emperor.

episodes.title: Knock, Knock, Knockin' on Hooty's Door
episodes.summary: Hooty tries to help King, Eda and Luz with their problems, but it doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Eclipse Lake
episodes.summary: When Luz gets sick with the Common Mold, it's up to Amity, King and Eda to find an important ingredient for the portal door—but they're not the only ones on its trail.

episodes.title: Yesterday's Lie
episodes.summary: Luz thinks she's found a way back home but questions if she's ready for what she'll find on the other side.

episodes.title: Follies at the Coven Day Parade
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of her trip home, Luz takes on daring rescue missions during the Coven Day parade.

episodes.title: Elsewhere and Elsewhen
episodes.summary: Luz is desperate for more information about Philip Wittebane, the creator of the portal door. With Lilith's help, she sets off on a journey for the ages.

episodes.title: Any Sport in a Storm
episodes.summary: Hunter goes undercover at Hexside for his most important mission yet. Meanwhile, Willow is determined to succeed at an exciting new sport.

episodes.title: Reaching Out
episodes.summary: Amity wants to prove herself to her father, and Luz thinks she's found the perfect way to do it: Underground Witch Duels.

episodes.title: Them's the Breaks, Kid
episodes.summary: Eda tells a story from her teen years: the day she met Raine Whispers.

episodes.title: Hollow Mind
episodes.summary: A magical mishap transports Luz and Hunter into a new mindscape…and this one is a twisted nightmare.

episodes.title: Edge of the World
episodes.summary: King's quest to uncover his past leads to shocking revelations and horrifying truths.

episodes.title: Labyrinth Runners
episodes.summary: When the Emperor's coven comes to Hexside, Gus teams up with an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: O Titan, Where Art Thou
episodes.summary: Eda and Luz scramble to face the Day of Unity. King faces his true identity.

episodes.title: Clouds on the Horizon
episodes.summary: Everyone on the Isles prepares to celebrate the Day of Unity.

episodes.title: King's Tide
episodes.summary: The Day of Unity begins.

episodes.title: Thanks to Them
episodes.summary: After months of trying, Luz and her friends make a daring attempt to return to the Demon Realm.

episodes.title: For the Future
episodes.summary: Luz and her friends race against Belos to confront the Collector and save the Boiling Isles.

episodes.title: Watching and Dreaming
episodes.summary: The fate of everything on the Boiling Isles now rests on the shoulders of a human, a cursed witch, and a determined but tiny little King.
